thread:
joel: Postmortem uploaded: brief - route-debounce bug caused rapid route flips during a capacity scale which, combined with service DNS TTL=20s, led to a TLS handshake retry spike for cross-region traffic (us-west-2 -> eu-west-1). full doc: https://redwood-internal/pms/248300.

rita: saw the spike on tls_errors_by_region at ~09:42-09:58 UTC. confirmed clients re-resolved while routes were unstable.

sre-bot: Incident INC-2026-065 logged; alerts suppressed while mitigations applied. :gear:

net-eng-ana: immediate mitigations applied: 1) temporary TTL increase to 600s for affected services (owner: net-eng-ana, ETA: 2h) 2) paused autoscaler that triggered the rapid rebalance (owner: mike, ETA: 15m).

mike: paused autoscale at 09:50 UTC; rollback of route publishes completed at 09:53 UTC. tls_err_rate dropped from 7.4% -> 0.9% in 10min.

joel: agreed follow-ups from triage: A) add route-debounce in controller to require stability window before publish (owner: mike, ETA: 4d) B) increase default global service TTL floor to 120s (owner: net-eng-ana, ETA: 3d) C) add TLS-handshake canary broken down by src_region (owner: rita, ETA: 48h) D) add checkbox in postmortem template for "recent autoscaler activity" (owner: joel, ETA: 2d).

rita: opening OBS ticket for region breakdown panels.

net-eng-ana: TTL emergency applied and validated via dig + curl. will schedule a controlled rollout for default TTL change.

mike: PR for controller debounce sketched, will post link when ready for review.

joel: creating JIRA tasks and will add recurring-incident tag: pattern=rapid-control-plane-flip + low-ttl. Please update tickets/PRs as you progress. closing thread for now. :white_check_mark:
